name: Marigold Intrinsic Appearance
description: Intrinsic image decomposition: separates surface colour from baked lighting and estimates material response. Gives Godot freedom to relight AI-painted art instead of being stuck with the illumination baked into the source.
notes: The IID node returns its maps concatenated on the BATCH dimension, not as separate outputs: index 0 = albedo (sRGB), index 1 = a packed material image with R=roughness and G=metallicity. The workflow splits the batch with ImageFromBatch, and the 'unpack' block above splits the packed material image into two real single-channel maps. Registering node 11 directly as 'roughness' kept the red channel and silently discarded the metallicity the model had already computed.
